name: Shape-picking game (5 minutes)
description:
This study investigates how people learn which features of a situation matter when several change at once.

You will play a game (approximately 5 minutes total) in which you click shapes to earn points. On each turn four shapes are shown and one of them earns a point; which one changes from time to time, and part of the task is working out which.

The task needs a desktop or laptop computer. There are no known risks beyond those of everyday computer use; you may experience mild boredom or fatigue. Full consent information is shown before the task begins.
